captions.detailed: This 3D model features a surveillance blimp with an elongated, aerodynamic light-gray envelope accented by blue stripes. Below the envelope, a small, light-blue sensor gondola is mounted, complete with a wheeled landing gear structure underneath. Dual engine nacelles with black propellers are positioned on either side of the aft section, while the tail assembly consists of a cruciform stabilizer arrangement. The propellers spin on their longitudinal axes, the vertical rudder pivots on its hinge, the horizontal elevators tilt on their hinges, and the landing gear wheels rotate on their axle.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a surveillance blimp with a long, streamlined envelope, a small gondola underneath, and side-mounted engine nacelles. The model should feature a structural wheeled landing gear and a rear cruciform tail assembly with separate vertical and horizontal control surfaces. Set up continuous rotation joints for the propellers and landing wheels, and revolute joints for the rudder and elevators.
captions.factory: The blimp envelope is constructed by lofting or scaling a series of circular sketches along a longitudinal axis. The gondola is created using a rounded box primitive, and the landing gear struts are built using cylinders connected to small cylinder wheels. The tail fins and control surfaces (rudder and elevators) are modeled from thin boxes and positioned at the rear using coordinate offsets. The engine nacelles are modeled as cylinders with small, multi-blade propeller assemblies attached via continuous joints, while the control surfaces are attached to the main stabilizers using revolute joints.
